policy_question.question: Does creator-attested '209k' satisfy the >=10,000 reach floor as a cited figure (recorded '209K'), or must it be 'unknown'?
policy_question.reasoning: 1) Creator-attested on her own official page: a single consistent figure, unlike the conflicting third-party abbreviations (87.1K/81.8K/82.5K) that sank @sarahdegheselle. 2) The dataset's own followers_approx convention already records cited K-figures (e.g. 234K, 189K rows); recording '209K' is consistent, not a lowering. 3) 209k is unambiguously above the 10,000 floor. 4) Recording 'unknown' would discard strictly-better evidence than many existing rows. Caveat to record in DB notes: figure is rounded to the nearest thousand by the creator herself; never present it as an exact integer.

Limitation: relative labels are week-granular, not day-exact.
